## Key Engineering & Performance Statistics
- **95+ Core Web Vitals & Lighthouse Scores:** Engineered fast First Contentful Paint (FCP), sub-2.0s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), 0 Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), and low Interaction to Next Paint (INP) across live production web apps.
- **100% Structured Data & Schema Coverage:** Architected rich JSON-LD Schema.org graphs, semantic HTML5, and llms.txt manifests for maximum visibility across traditional search engines (Google, Bing) and AI search agents (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini).
- **45+ Optimized REST API Endpoints:** Built and tested robust endpoints, streaming responses, lean payloads, and HTTP cache headers with Postman.
- **3.5x Organic & Generative AI Discoverability:** Delivered end-to-end Technical SEO, Answer Engine (AEO), and Generative Engine (GEO) strategies on live web applications.

## Core Competencies & Technical Skills
- **Software Engineering:** TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, Next.js (App Router, SSR, SSG), Node.js, HTML5, Modern CSS / Tailwind CSS.
- **Web Performance Engineering:** Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP), Lighthouse profiling, bundle splitting, lazy loading, font optimization, critical CSS, CDN and edge caching.
- **Technical SEO, AEO, GEO & AIO:** Comprehensive JSON-LD Schema graphs, semantic document hierarchy, OpenGraph/Twitter cards, crawl budget management, canonicalization, robots.txt directives, XML sitemaps, and llms.txt generative engine manifests.
- **Backend & APIs:** REST API design, Postman automated collections, HTTP/HTTPS security headers, payload compression, payload schema validation.
- **Developer Tools & CI/CD:** Git, GitHub, VS Code, automated testing (Playwright), continuous integration workflows.
